centralQuestion: How do we communicate the intended character motion to the animator?
thesis: A motion inventory, time requirements and readable pose references form a shared target. Animators realize the movement, iterate for character and player experience, and share what the team learns.
scriptState: KO independently phrased and locked to 3368-character continuous own-voice take; paired English and 183 clause units prepared. Final exact cut timing pending.
